c.title: C Systems Roadmap
c.tagline: Master memory pointers, hardware interaction, operating systems, and embedded computing.
why_learn: The mother of modern programming languages — unlocks true understanding of hardware & memory.
Essential for Operating System kernels (Linux/Windows), drivers, and embedded microcontrollers.
Teaches explicit pointer arithmetic, manual memory allocation (`malloc`/`free`), and stack/heap mechanics.
Unmatched execution speed and minimal runtime footprint.
what_you_will_learn: C syntax, data types, operators, and control structures.
Functions, scope, header files, and preprocessor directives.
Pointers, address arithmetic, memory layout, dynamic memory allocation (`malloc`, `free`).
Structures (`struct`), Unions, Bit manipulation, File I/O, and custom data structures.

cpp.title: C++ High-Performance Roadmap
cpp.tagline: Master modern C++, STL, competitive programming, game engine architecture, and high-frequency systems.
why_learn: Industry standard for high-performance software: Game Engines (Unreal Engine), Trading Systems, and Browsers.
Blends low-level control of C with modern Object-Oriented and Generic Programming features.
Rich Standard Template Library (STL) essential for Data Structures & Competitive Programming.
Modern C++ (C++11 to C++20) provides smart pointers, move semantics, and safe abstractions.
what_you_will_learn: C++ syntax, references, streams, and control flow.
Classes, Constructors/Destructors, Operator Overloading, and Inheritance.
Pointers, Smart Pointers (`unique_ptr`, `shared_ptr`), and RAII memory management.
Standard Template Library (Vector, Map, Set, Queue), Algorithms, Templates, and Lambda expressions.

dbms.title: DBMS & Database Engineering Roadmap
dbms.tagline: Design robust relational schemas, master SQL queries, normalization, and ACID transaction mechanics.
why_learn: Data is the foundation of modern applications — databases power every tech company.
SQL is an indispensable skill required across software engineering, data science, and DevOps.
Teaches relational data modeling, indexing, and query optimization for high performance.
Crucial understanding of data integrity, transactions, and ACID guarantees.
what_you_will_learn: Relational model, primary keys, foreign keys, and ER diagrams.
SQL Data Definition (DDL) and Data Manipulation (DML) statements.
Complex SQL Joins, Aggregations (`GROUP BY`, `HAVING`), and Subqueries.
Database Normalization (1NF to 3NF/BCNF), Indexing, and ACID Transactions.
